visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short brown hair and glasses, wearing a white sleeveless collared shirt, sits at a dark wooden table in a modern kitchen setting. She looks directly at the camera while holding a white circular cotton pad. The background features warm wood paneling, a marble-topped island, and a sleek faucet. (2) A sharp close-up shows the woman's hands holding the white cotton pad, which has faint yellowish-brown stains in the center. A red circle overlay appears to highlight the discoloration. (3) The scene returns to the woman at the table, gesturing with her hands as she speaks. A black and gold Dyson device is visible on the floor behind her. (4) A different shot shows a hand smoothing out a grey striped bedsheet in a well-lit bedroom, emphasizing the texture of the fabric. (5) Back to the woman at the kitchen table; she continues her explanation, using expansive hand gestures to describe environmental particles. (6) A brief shot of a different woman in a white bathrobe sitting at a table with a mirror, carefully using a glass dropper to apply a clear liquid serum to her cheek. (7) The camera focuses on a Dyson air purifier (model with gold and navy blue accents) standing on a wooden floor. The circular display on the device shows changing icons and data related to air quality (NO2, PM10, etc.). (8) Hands are shown interacting with the device, pressing red latches to open the side panels and revealing the multi-layered HEPA and carbon filters inside. (9) A wide shot displays a spacious, luxuriously designed living room with large windows, a television, and a wooden room divider. The Dyson air purifier sits prominently in the corner, with animated sparkles added to signify clean air.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A woman with short dark hair, wearing round black-rimmed glasses and a white sleeveless collared shirt. She wears a watch on her left wrist and a ring on her right hand.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A modern, high-end interior featuring a marble kitchen island, warm wood cabinetry, a bedroom with clean grey bedding, and a large open-plan living room with built-in bookshelves and large windows.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a clear, professional female voice speaking in a steady, informative Mandarin tone. Background music consists of a bright, major-key acoustic guitar strumming at a moderate tempo. (2) As the speaker's tone shifts to emphasize the dirt on the cotton pad, a subtle 'whoosh' transition sound occurs. The BGM remains consistent in volume and texture. (3) During the bedroom and skincare clips, faint fabric rustling and liquid sounds are audible beneath the continuous narration and acoustic guitar bed. (4) As the air purifier is showcased, mechanical clicking and the soft sound of filter panels sliding into place are heard, mixed prominently to highlight technical quality. (5) The narration reaches a concluding tone with slightly higher vocal energy, while the acoustic guitar track maintains its rhythmic pattern until the fade-out.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the Dyson air purifier by connecting indoor air pollutants to skin instability. The creator uses the visual evidence of a dirty cotton pad to establish a problem, explains the source of indoor pollutants like NO2 and formaldehyde, and then presents the Dyson device's advanced filtration technology as the necessary solution for maintaining both health and beauty in a home environment.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct demonstration of the Dyson air purifier, detailed explanation of its technical specs (HEPA H13, SCO filter), and a clear call to its efficacy in large spaces.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video blends skincare advice with high-tech home appliance promotion, targeting health-conscious viewers interested in premium lifestyle products. The production quality is high with clean audio and professional lighting.
